title: shared space for care and veche
subtitle: clear question · distinct voices · manageable step · preserved trace
scope: a shared, depersonalised foundation for individual and collective systems; a local discussion workshop
purpose: connect knowledge, a care agency and joint deliberation so that a person can configure the system independently and check the next step
outcome: read the method, record a contribution or position, see the differences and save a portable discussion package
statusNote: design specification and local prototype candidate; networked agents, messages, money, legal organisation and publication are off
preservation: useful methods, versions and unresolved materials are preserved; originals are not destroyed, and selected transfers are reversible and have source → target, SHA and a receipt
privacy: the common layer contains methods, roles and empty templates; personal stories, contacts, correspondence and sensitive information remain within the chosen private area
metaphor: care angel is an optional interface metaphor; people and agents can use a plain role description without assigning identity or experiences
localState: workshop records are held in the page's memory; save the JSON before closing. import adds checked records without replacing the original history
identityNote: participant type and name in this local workshop are declared by the record's author; other participants' identities, authority and consent have not been verified here

ui.draftOnly: draft only; no decision or launch has taken place
ui.privateExport: export is private; publication requires a separate selection
ui.countsNote: counters show local records, not verified human votes or a quorum
ui.sourceDraft: language draft; independent review and author acceptance are pending
ui.yzhNote: язэхъ is an authorial experiment; here it has an explicitly labelled meaning expansion and a separate, controlled candidate record
ui.noExternal: network and external actions are off
ui.fileChosen: choose a previously saved discussion JSON

sections.title: completeness and preservation
sections.body: first preserve the original and its context, then identify the distinction that can be carried over. similar files do not automatically become a single canon. unresolved material remains available with a clear label; working archives are kept outside the clean common assembly

sections.title: depersonalised common core
sections.body: each method describes its purpose, invariant, input, action, result, source, rights, version and boundaries. a personal name or story is not needed for the method to work. depersonalisation preserves a useful distinction without presenting a private case as a universal law

sections.title: individual and collective configuration
sections.body: a personal profile, chosen language, pace and accessibility are connected separately. a collective defines its own roles, visibility and decision-making scope. settings can be edited and exported; another person's identity, consent or participation cannot be inferred from a template

sections.title: care agency
sections.body: entry begins with a chosen question. identify a manageable action, the resource needed and the person making the decision. a bot does not allocate assistance, grants, payments or representation. a request can be clarified, passed to a suitable person or brought to a close

sections.title: care in agent work
sections.body: an agent receives a clear task, permitted sources, a data boundary and an available budget. it records uncertainty, recurring failure, a pause and a handover. this is an operational arrangement of the process; feelings, suffering, consciousness or human needs are not attributed to the agent

sections.title: a place for communication
sections.body: people and agents can prepare a contribution with explicit provenance. a message is material for consideration, not an execution command. hidden reasoning, secrets, raw private correspondence and unsolicited personal records are not included in the common package

sections.title: the veche process
sections.body: each proposal receives a question, context and a way to check it. support, objection, abstention and no response are stored separately. silence is not consent. an AI perspective is not a human vote; the outcome has a responsible human and remains a draft until that person's separate decision

sections.title: checking the basis
sections.body: claim type, source, verification and decision are separate fields. PASS applies to an explicit criterion and environment. UNKNOWN is retained when data is insufficient; elegant wording does not increase certainty. COMMIT is not publication, and a specification is not a working service

sections.title: participation boundaries
sections.body: the metaphor, play and participation are voluntary. plain language, correction, pause and exit are available. age-specific routes do not replace an official classification; youth intake is off pending separate conditions, and the first pilot is for consenting adults. emergency and clinical assistance are not claimed here

sections.title: connecting existing agents
sections.body: a proposed adapter transfers only the selected contribution, role, source, version and permission scope. import does not verify the author, rights or consent. network transport, secrets, permissions, an operator and a log require separate implementation and verification; they are currently off

sections.title: languages and meaning transfer
sections.body: each edition is linked to the Russian source and its SHA. names, IDs, enums and code are preserved. negations, uncertainty, choice and consequences are checked. язэхъ receives a separate experimental status; its unknown meanings are not filled in by guesswork

sections.title: an accessible result
sections.body: choose an area and a question; add a contribution, proposal or position; check the source; save the JSON; if needed, import selected records into another local workshop. your own export does not automatically become shared or public

roles.label: initiator
roles.scope: formulates the question, context and criterion of usefulness

roles.label: contributor
roles.scope: adds a basis, option, example or limitation

roles.label: reviewer
roles.scope: compares sources, consequences and losses of meaning

roles.label: responsible human
roles.scope: makes a separate decision within their verified scope; a local role label does not confer authority

workflow.title: question
workflow.body: what is important to understand, express or check?

workflow.title: context
workflow.body: what has been selected for joint consideration, and on what basis?

workflow.title: proposal
workflow.body: what manageable step is proposed, and how can its result be observed?

workflow.title: distinguishing positions
workflow.body: what has been supported, challenged, deferred or left unanswered?

workflow.title: review
workflow.body: have the basis, boundaries and right to choose been preserved?

workflow.title: draft outcome
workflow.body: what remains on HOLD, and what decision must a person make?

workflow.title: trace and return
workflow.body: save what was selected, check the result, correct it or finish

positions.label: support
positions.meaning: support for the stated proposal within the named scope

positions.label: objection
positions.meaning: a specific limitation, risk or alternative explanation

positions.label: abstention
positions.meaning: no position is being taken for now; the reason may remain unknown

positions.label: no response
positions.meaning: no response has been received; this is neither consent nor abstention

modules.function: accessible navigation through methods and routes chosen by the person

modules.function: invitation, acceptance of a role, agreed conditions and exit

modules.function: precise verification scope, evidence, errors and corrections

modules.title: knowledge crystal
modules.function: a method understandable on its own, with a source, boundaries and version

modules.function: several perspectives with explicit hypothesis or symbol status

modules.function: terms, voice, direct transcreations and a check for meaning loss
